# C S Kakkad & Associates — Chartered Accountants

> Premier Chartered Accountancy and financial advisory firm based in Dwarka, Gujarat, India. Led by CA Chintan S. Kakkad (F.C.A., B.Com) with over 12 years of specialized practice in statutory audit, taxation, GST, loan syndication, and corporate consultancy.

## Core Practice Areas
1. **Statutory & Tax Audit:** Mandatory audits under Companies Act 2013, Tax Audits under Section 44AB of the Income Tax Act 1961, and internal control reviews.
2. **Direct Taxation (Income Tax):** Individual and corporate ITR filings, advance tax planning, capital gains computations, TDS returns, and representation before income tax assessment officers.
3. **Goods & Services Tax (GST):** Digital GST registration, monthly GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B filings, annual GSTR-9 returns, and GSTR-2B Input Tax Credit (ITC) audits.
4. **Business Finance & Loan Syndication:** Formulation of bankable Project Reports, CMA (Credit Monitoring Arrangement) data modeling, CC limits, term loan syndication, and MSME financing.
5. **Corporate Consultancy & Setup:** Private Limited incorporation, Limited Liability Partnership (LLP) formation, partnership deeds, Udyam MSME registration, and ROC annual filings.
6. **Accounting & Outsourcing:** Full-cycle cloud bookkeeping, monthly MIS reporting, bank reconciliation, and payroll processing.
